intro.h2: Small team, direct line to the owner
paragraphs: A+ Custom Builders handles bathroom remodeling in Seekonk, MA and the towns along the Massachusetts and Rhode Island line. Founder Greg DeSilva started the company in January 2018 after years in commercial construction in Boston. The work is done by his in-house team, not handed off to outside crews.

Homeowners who review A+ keep naming the same things: steady communication with Greg, a clean and respectful crew, and bathrooms that come out beautiful. Before you even book a visit, you can run the online cost calculator to see a ballpark range for your project, with no salesperson and no credit card.

services.h2: Bathroom remodeling in Seekonk, MA and more

items.name: Bathroom Remodeling
items.blurb: Full bathroom renovations, master baths and guest half baths. Popular requests include walk-in tiled showers with glass enclosures, double vanities, heated tile floors and freestanding soaking tubs. Recent work includes a Swansea master bath on Dillon Lane and an Edgewood guest bath in Seekonk.

image.alt: Swansea, MA bathroom remodel with a black double vanity, octagon mosaic floor tile and a frameless glass shower

items.name: Kitchen Remodeling
items.blurb: New cabinets, countertops, backsplashes and layouts, from modern makeovers with better storage to full custom redesigns. Kitchen projects on the site include Wood Street, Lewin, Lawrence Street and a kitchen in Warren, Rhode Island, all built by the in-house team.

image.alt: Kitchen remodel in Swansea, MA with white shaker cabinets, a navy island with stone top, herringbone backsplash and stainless range hood

items.name: Basement Finishing
items.blurb: Unfinished basements turned into family rooms, gyms, offices or guest suites. Recent basement projects include Oxford, Pine Hill, Brook Street and Mt Hope Bay. You can price a basement with the same online calculator before asking for a free estimate.

image.alt: Finished basement in the Seekonk area with wood-look plank flooring, recessed lights and French doors

items.name: Decks, Patios and Pavilions
items.blurb: Custom decks, stamped concrete and paver patios, and covered pavilions built for New England seasons. Projects include the Winter Drive pavilion, the Rose Court deck and patio, and a Westport backyard the team calls the Westport Oasis.

image.alt: Lit composite deck stairs with black railings behind a white two-story home at dusk

items.text: Reviewers mention the owner by name. One wrote that Greg was in constant communication during their main bathroom remodel and answered every question or concern.

items.title: The crew is in-house
items.text: A+ says it delivers results without outsourcing the work. The same skilled team that quotes your bathroom is the team that builds it.

items.title: Prices before the pitch
items.text: The online cost calculator gives you a price range in a few minutes. There is no salesperson, no credit card, and A+ promises not to spam you.

about.text: Greg DeSilva built his early career in commercial construction in Boston. He found that he liked residential remodeling more, and in January 2018 he started A+ Custom Builders in Seekonk. The company runs on three core values he lays out plainly: work smarter and harder, never cut corners on craftsmanship, and stay loyal to clients and to each other. Greg is still the person homeowners talk to. Reviews describe him answering questions throughout the job, and the team he leads is the same crew that shows up to build.

image.alt: Gregory DeSilva, founder of A+ Custom Builders in Seekonk, MA

process.h2: From price range to finished room in four steps

steps.title: Check your price range
steps.text: Use the online calculator to see what your bathroom, kitchen or basement may cost. You can edit your answers at the end.

steps.title: Personal consultation
steps.text: Greg's team learns your goals, style and budget, whether you want to update a half bath or fully renovate a master suite.

steps.title: Selections and design
steps.text: Choose tile, vanities, lighting, fixtures and finishes with help from the team, picked for your style and daily wear.

steps.title: Construction by the A+ crew
steps.text: The in-house team builds the plan with clear communication, a clean site and attention to every detail.

service_area.h2: Serving Seekonk, the South Coast and Rhode Island
service_area.text: A+ is based on Arcade Avenue in Seekonk and works in Seekonk, Rehoboth, East Providence, Barrington and across the South Coast of Massachusetts and nearby Rhode Island. Featured projects on the site come from Rehoboth, Swansea, Seekonk, Westport and Warren, Rhode Island. If your home sits near the state line on either side, a quick call or text will confirm whether it falls inside the crew's regular range.

faq.h2: Common questions for A+ Custom Builders

items.q: Can I see a price before anyone comes to my house?
items.a: Yes. The cost calculator on the A+ site gives you a ballpark range for your bathroom, kitchen, basement or outdoor project in a few minutes. No credit card is needed. It asks for your contact details at the end, and A+ promises not to spam you with emails or calls.

Yes. A+ offers a free quote and estimate. Fill out the short form, or call or text Greg's office at (401) 225-7875. The website lists hours of Monday through Sunday, 7am to 6pm, so you can reach the team on weekends too.

An in-house A+ team. The company says it does not outsource the work, so the crew you meet is the crew that builds. Greg DeSilva stays involved, and Google reviewers describe him answering questions and concerns throughout their bathroom remodels.

items.q: What do Seekonk homeowners ask for in a new bathroom?
items.a: The most requested upgrades A+ sees are walk-in tiled showers with glass enclosures, double vanities, heated tile floors, freestanding soaking tubs, better lighting and ventilation, and custom linen storage or shelving. The team helps you pick tile, vanities and fixtures during the design step.

items.q: Do you work in Rhode Island?
items.a: Yes. Besides Seekonk, Rehoboth and the South Coast, A+ serves East Providence and Barrington, and its kitchen portfolio includes a remodel in Warren, Rhode Island. On the Massachusetts side, finished projects in Swansea and Westport show how far along the South Coast the crew already works.

final_cta.text: Run the calculator for a quick range, or call Greg's team for a free quote.
